title: Sr. Automated QA Engineer - FinTech Engineering

cond_0001.intro: Our FinTech Engineering team at [Company name masked] is looking for a Sr. QA Engineer to join our commercial group, delivering digital experiences to our referral partner and small business channels.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Develop & execute automated tests using our testing framework including Cypress, Postman, Mocha + Chai, JavaScript, and Node.js. Perform tests across web, mobile, and api. Participate comprehensively in testing including: integration, functional, end-to-end, performance, smoke, regression, etc. Be an active participant in the agile development process. Work with Engineers and Technical Product Managers to build test plans and execute accordingly. Review bug reports & escalated support tickets as needed. Ensure bugs and all quality issues are documented, tracked, and resolved. Review, analyze, and diagnose issues appropriately. Identify application weaknesses and target areas. Work with QA Lead and Tech Leadership to solve faults. Contribute to a continuously improving testing program, specifically in regards to efficiency and automation. Understand the business requirements and user journeys as applicable to testing.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
4+ Years as a QA Auto Engineer, with strong design, coding, and debugging skills
Experience with Cypress, Postman, JavaScript, Node.js, Mocha + Chai
Manual testing experience and expertise
Experience testing web-based applications & working in a cloud based development environment
Preferred Requirements
Relevant experience with related technologies will also be considered
Extensive experience within agile development teams, including working directly in pods of 5+ engineers
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
